# OpenGlazed — GitHub Copilot Instructions

Read this entire file before suggesting any code. These rules are non-negotiable.

---

## What This Project Is

OpenGlazed is a SaaS platform that embeds an AI sales chatbot on any business website.
It scrapes the business site, builds a retrieval index, and answers visitor questions
using retrieved context passed to an OpenAI chat model. It captures leads and shows them on a dashboard.

---

## Stack — Exact, No Exceptions

| Layer | Technology | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Backend API | Node.js + Express | NOT Python, NOT FastAPI |
| Frontend | React 19 + Vite + React Router | |
| Database | PostgreSQL + pgvector (local Docker) | NOT SQLite, NOT ChromaDB, NOT Supabase cloud |
| Generation | OpenAI chat (gpt-4o-mini) | Via `openai` SDK in generator.js |
| Embeddings | OpenAI `text-embedding-3-small` (1536-dim) | Via `openai` SDK in services/embeddings.js |
| Reranking (optional) | cross-encoder via `MODEL_API_URL` | Skipped if unset; RRF used instead |
| Scraping | Cheerio (Node.js) | NOT BeautifulSoup, NOT Playwright |

---

## Architecture Rules — Read Every Line

### Generation
- All generation calls live in `backend/src/services/generator.js` ONLY.
- Generation uses the OpenAI chat API (gpt-4o-mini) via the `openai` SDK.
- Never call generation directly from routes, from db.js, or from retriever.js.
- If generation fails → return first retrieved chunk as raw answer, escalated: false.

### Embeddings
- All embeddings come from OpenAI `text-embedding-3-small` (1536-dim) via `backend/src/services/embeddings.js`.
- Never call a self-hosted model server for embeddings. The `MODEL_API_URL` env var is ONLY for an optional rerank service.

### Retrieval
- All retrieval logic lives in `backend/src/services/retriever.js` ONLY.
- Retrieval order: query rewrite → embed → BM25 + dense parallel → RRF → rerank → confidence check.
- Dense retrieval calls SQL function `match_chunks` / `match_summaries` (defined in `db/init.sql`).
- BM25 calls SQL function `match_chunks_fts`.
- Never do ad-hoc SQL from routes/service files — use the helper functions in `db.js` (or `db.query` for one-offs).

### Database
- All DB access goes through helper functions in `backend/src/db.js` (node-postgres `pg` pool).
- Never call `supabase` — the project is fully local Postgres, no Supabase client exists.
- Schema + retrieval functions live in `db/init.sql` (auto-applied by docker-compose). Use `ALTER`, never `DROP`.
- Tables: businesses, chunks, summaries, leads, messages, chat_sessions, questions, eval_logs, training_jobs.

### RAPTOR Chunking (ingest.js)
- Level 0: raw chunks from scraper (recursive character splitting, max 600 chars, 80 char overlap)
- Level 1: cluster summaries generated by the OpenAI chat model (clustering falls back to a single flat cluster when no `MODEL_API_URL` is set)
- Level 2: site-level summary generated by the OpenAI chat model (one per business)
- Levels 1+2 stored in `summaries` table, Level 0 in `chunks` table.

## Dead Files — Do Not Reference or Restore

These files existed in an earlier version and must NOT be referenced in new code:

- `backend/src/services/trainer.js` — per-business training is gone
- `model-server/` — self-hosted FastAPI model server is gone (API-first app)
- `training/` — Colab fine-tuning notebooks are gone (API-first app)
- Any reference to SQLite, sqlite3, better-sqlite3
- Any reference to ChromaDB, chromadb
- Any reference to rank_bm25, BM25Okapi Python library
- Any reference to Llama, llama-3b, llama_cpp, Phi-3, QLoRA, bitsandbytes

---

## Naming Conventions

- `businessId` in Node.js (camelCase) = `business_id` in Postgres (snake_case)
- Chat sessions identified by `sessionId` (UUID, generated client-side)
- Confidence levels: `"high"` | `"medium"` | `"low"` (strings, not numbers)
- Ingest status: `"pending"` | `"ingesting"` | `"active"` | `"error"`

---

## Response Shape — Chat Route

Every POST /api/chat/:businessId response must have this exact shape:
```json
{
  "response": "string or null",
  "escalated": true,
  "source": "model | retriever-only | escalation | model-escalation",
  "confidence": "high | medium | low",
  "sessionId": "string"
}
```
Never add fields. Never remove fields. Frontend depends on this shape exactly.
